reviews.body: I’ve been using the 20lb weighted vest for my workouts and have been really happy with it so far. reviews.title: Comfortable and Effective, but Limited Adjustability
reviews.body: I've been using this weighted vest as a way to keep up my training on days when I don't have time to make it to the gym. I work in a fulfillment center and spend a lot of time on my feet, so adding the vest to walks and other activities has been a convenient way to increase the intensity of my workouts.The material is comfortable, and there is enough padding that the vest doesn't feel harsh or uncomfortable during extended use. It feels durable and well made, and the weight is distributed reasonably well throughout the vest.My main complaints are that the vest runs a bit small and tends to bunch up around the shoulders while wearing it. After a while, I noticed it could feel slightly restrictive in that area. I also wish the weight was adjustable. Being able to add or remove weight would make the vest much more versatile as fitness levels and training goals change.There is also some minor limitation in range of motion compared to exercising without a vest, though that's somewhat expected with weighted gear. Overall, it's a solid weighted vest that gets the job done, but a better fit and adjustable weights would make it even better.

reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.body: The ZELUS weighted vest is a solid addition to any workout routine, whether you’re walking, running, or doing strength training. It feels well-balanced when worn, and the weight is distributed evenly so it doesn’t feel awkward or shift too much during movement.The material is durable and holds up well during regular use, and the adjustable straps make it easy to get a secure, comfortable fit for different body types. I also like the reflective stripe—it’s a great safety feature for outdoor workouts, especially in low light.It adds just the right amount of resistance without feeling overly bulky, which makes it great for increasing workout intensity gradually. The vest stays in place pretty well once adjusted, and it doesn’t restrict movement too much.Overall, this is a practical and effective weighted vest that’s comfortable enough for consistent use. A great option for anyone looking to level up their cardio or strength training.
